sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Karina Holmer scratched the final panel on the lottery ticket and was surprised to discover that she'd won 10,000 Swedish krona.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜·霍尔默（Karina Holmer）刮开了彩票的最后一栏，惊喜地发现自己中了1万瑞典克朗。

sentences.en: The win couldn't have come at a better time.
sentences.zh: 这笔奖金来得正是时候。

sentences.en: It was only one week until 19-year-old Karina was set to leave her small Swedish village in Schillingerud to travel to the USA.
sentences.zh: 当时19岁的卡琳娜再过一周就要离开瑞典席林格鲁德（Schillingerud）的小村庄，前往美国了。

sentences.en: Her unexpected but welcome windfall, which in 1996 was the equivalent of roughly 1,500
sentences.zh: 这笔意外之财在1996年约合1500美元，

sentences.en: US dollars, granted Karina extra spending money for her overseas adventure.
sentences.zh: 为卡琳娜的海外冒险提供了额外的零花钱。

sentences.en: Karina wasn't going to the United States just for a holiday.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜去美国不仅仅是为了度假。

sentences.en: She had signed up to be an au pair with a company in Sweden that matched young women with American families looking for nannies.
sentences.zh: 她通过瑞典的一家公司报名成为了互惠生（au pair），该公司专门为寻找保姆的美国家庭匹配年轻女性。

sentences.en: Karina would provide childcare and light housekeeping duties to her host family, and in return they would give her board and a small allowance.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜将为寄宿家庭提供育儿和简单的家务服务，作为回报，他们会提供食宿和少量津贴。

sentences.en: One of Karina's three sisters previously worked as an au pair and had encouraged her to do the same as a way to experience living overseas.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜的三个姐妹中有一个曾做过互惠生，她鼓励卡琳娜也去尝试一下，以此体验海外生活。

sentences.en: The arrangement would also help Karina save money, which she could put towards pursuing her ultimate career goal of becoming a restaurant manager.
sentences.zh: 这次安排还能帮卡琳娜存钱，为她实现成为餐厅经理的职业目标打下基础。

sentences.en: Driven and passionate, Karina had already completed trade school in the hospitality industry.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜积极进取、充满热情，此前已在酒店管理行业完成了职业培训。

sentences.en: The company matched Karina with a family in the affluent town of Dover, around 15 miles southwest of downtown Boston, Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 公司为卡琳娜匹配了一个位于多佛（Dover）富人区的家庭，该镇位于马萨诸塞州波士顿市中心西南约15英里处。

sentences.en: She was looking forward to exploring Boston, as she'd never experienced life in a bustling city before.
sentences.zh: 她非常期待探索波士顿，因为她从未体验过繁华大城市的生活。

sentences.en: In March 1996, Karina prepared to leave her small village of fewer than 100 people for
sentences.zh: 1996年3月，卡琳娜准备离开她那个不到100人的小村庄，前往人口约4000人的

sentences.en: Dover, which had a population of around 4,000.
sentences.zh: 多佛。

sentences.en: Although outgoing and social, Karina was quite dependent on her friends and family.
sentences.zh: 尽管性格外向、善于社交，但卡琳娜在很大程度上仍依赖于朋友和家人。

sentences.en: By working in America, she hoped to show her parents that she could stand on her own two feet.
sentences.zh: 通过在美国工作，她希望能向父母证明自己能够独立生活。

sentences.en: Karina was happy and excited as she farewelled her family at the airport.
sentences.zh: 在机场与家人告别时，卡琳娜感到既幸福又兴奋。

sentences.en: Just before she boarded the plane, she said, I hope I'm doing the right thing.
sentences.zh: 就在登机前，她说：“希望我做的决定是正确的。”

sentences.en: Upon arriving in Dover, Karina settled in well with her host family.
sentences.zh: 抵达多佛后，卡琳娜很快适应了寄宿家庭的生活。

sentences.en: 43-year-old Frank Rapp worked as a photographer.
sentences.zh: 43岁的弗兰克·拉普（Frank Rapp）是一名摄影师。

sentences.en: His wife, Susan Nicta, was an artist who painted for a living.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子苏珊·尼克塔（Susan Nicta）是一位以绘画为生的艺术家。

sentences.en: The couple had two children, a six-year-old boy and a toddler-aged daughter.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇有两个孩子，一个六岁的男孩和一个蹒跚学步的女儿。

sentences.en: Frank and Susan weren't strangers to hosting an au pair.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克和苏珊对接待互惠生并不陌生。

sentences.en: Karina was the sixth Swedish nanny to stay with them.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜是第六位与他们同住的瑞典保姆。

sentences.en: Described by neighbours as a well-to-do couple, Frank and Susan's three-storey, landscaped home offered Karina ample space and privacy when needed.
sentences.zh: 邻居们形容这对夫妇家境优渥，他们那栋带景观的三层住宅为卡琳娜提供了充足的空间和隐私。

sentences.en: Naturally athletic as a Pony Club member and one-time Girl Scout, Karina spent her days playing games such as soccer and basketball with the children.
sentences.zh: 作为马术俱乐部成员和前女童子军，卡琳娜天生运动细胞发达，经常陪孩子们玩足球和篮球。

sentences.en: Her time was also spent completing household chores.
sentences.zh: 她的大部分时间也花在处理家务上。

sentences.en: The two children quickly grew fond of Karina, who was gentle, patient, affectionate, and optimistic.
sentences.zh: 两个孩子很快就喜欢上了温柔、耐心、充满爱心且乐观的卡琳娜。

sentences.en: In the evenings, she often joined other au pairs at nightclubs and cafes in the Boston area.
sentences.zh: 晚上，她经常和波士顿地区的其他互惠生一起去夜店和咖啡馆。

sentences.en: She formed close friendships with her colleagues, and the young women bonded over their shared experiences in a foreign country.
sentences.zh: 她与同事们建立了深厚的友谊，这些年轻女性因在异国他乡的共同经历而结下了纽带。

sentences.en: As Karina only worked weekdays, Frank Rapp made her an offer.
sentences.zh: 由于卡琳娜只在工作日上班，弗兰克·拉普向她提出了一个建议。

sentences.en: It was one he had made to all the nannies who had looked after his children in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 他过去曾向所有照顾过他孩子的保姆都提出过同样的建议。

sentences.en: On weekends, Karina could crash at his loft apartment in South Boston, which he used as a photography studio.
sentences.zh: 周末，卡琳娜可以住在他在南波士顿的阁楼公寓里，那里也是他的摄影工作室。

sentences.en: This would allow her to enjoy Boston on her days off without having to worry about making her way back to Dover each night.
sentences.zh: 这样她就可以在休息日尽情享受波士顿，而不必担心每天晚上赶回多佛。

sentences.en: Karina eagerly accepted and spent the majority of her weekends in the city with her au pair friends.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜欣然接受，并把大部分周末都花在城里与互惠生朋友们在一起。

sentences.en: One of the most exciting dates on the Swedish calendar is mid-summer, celebrated at the summer solstice, the longest day of the year.
sentences.zh: 瑞典日历中最令人兴奋的日子之一是仲夏节，在夏至这一年中最长的一天庆祝。

sentences.en: On Friday, June 21, 1996, when Karina Holmer was three months into her American adventure,
sentences.zh: 1996年6月21日，星期五，当卡琳娜·霍尔默的美国冒险之旅进行到第三个月时，

sentences.en: she decided that being on the other side of the world gave her no less reason to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 她认为身处地球的另一端并没有减少她庆祝的理由。

sentences.en: Karina told her host family that she planned to go to Boston for the weekend and would be back on Sunday evening.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜告诉寄宿家庭，她计划去波士顿过周末，周日晚上回来。

sentences.en: She pulled on a grey and silver sweater, shiny grey pants, and black ankle boots, before leaving for the city on Friday afternoon with another female nanny.
sentences.zh: 周五下午，她穿上一件灰银色的毛衣、闪亮的灰色长裤和黑色短靴，与另一位女保姆一起出发前往市区。

sentences.en: The two made their way to Boylston Place in downtown Boston.
sentences.zh: 两人前往波士顿市中心的博伊尔斯顿广场（Boylston Place）。

sentences.en: The area, brimming with nightclubs, was known to au pairs and locals alike as a popular place for international tourists.
sentences.zh: 该地区夜店林立，在互惠生和当地人眼中，是国际游客的热门去处。

sentences.en: Karina and her friend chose to visit two nightclubs, Zanzibar and Mercury Bar, as many from their social circle would be there.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜和朋友选择了去两家夜店，Zanzibar和Mercury Bar，因为她们社交圈里的许多人都会在那里。

sentences.en: At five foot three inches tall and with a face described as sweet and innocent,
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜·霍尔默身高五英尺三英寸，长着一张被形容为甜美无辜的脸，

sentences.en: Karina Holmer looked more like a 16-year-old than her nearly 20 years.
sentences.zh: 看起来比她快20岁的年纪更像个16岁的少女。

sentences.en: This, coupled with the fact that the legal drinking age in the US was 21, meant she had to use a fake ID to get into the clubs.
sentences.zh: 再加上美国法定饮酒年龄是21岁，这意味着她必须使用假身份证才能进入夜店。

sentences.en: It worked, as it had many times before.
sentences.zh: 这招很管用，就像之前很多次一样。

sentences.en: Karina and her group of approximately a dozen friends spent the night drinking and dancing.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜和她大约十几人的朋友团队整晚都在喝酒跳舞。

sentences.en: At two the following morning, they spilled out onto the street as Zanzibar closed its doors.
sentences.zh: 次日凌晨两点，随着Zanzibar关门，她们涌向了街头。

sentences.en: Karina, who was heavily intoxicated, began talking and dancing with passers-by, including a nearby panhandler.
sentences.zh: 醉意朦胧的卡琳娜开始与路人交谈跳舞，其中包括附近的一名乞丐。

sentences.en: She also stopped to chat to a man walking a large white dog, both of whom were dressed in matching Superman t-shirts.
sentences.zh: 她还停下来与一名遛着大白狗的男子聊天，两人都穿着同款的超人T恤。

sentences.en: Half an hour after leaving Zanzibar, Karina was still outside the club, having a conversation with two men.
sentences.zh: 离开Zanzibar半小时后，卡琳娜仍待在店外，与两名男子交谈。

sentences.en: Her friend, who was sitting in a nearby car, asked her boyfriend to tell Karina they were leaving.
sentences.zh: 坐在附近车里的朋友让男友去告诉卡琳娜她们要走了。

sentences.en: As the boyfriend spoke with Karina, the two men she was with began swearing at him, asking,
sentences.zh: 当男友与卡琳娜交谈时，与她在一起的两名男子开始对他咒骂，质问道：

sentences.en: Who do you think you are?
sentences.zh: “你以为你是谁？”

sentences.en: When Karina heard her friends were leaving, she opted to stay behind, replying that she would see them later.
sentences.zh: 当卡琳娜听说朋友们要走时，她选择留下来，回答说她稍后再找她们。

sentences.en: On Sunday June 23, the day Karina was expected to return to Dover, her employer, Frank Rapp, received a phone call.
sentences.zh: 6月23日星期日，即卡琳娜本应返回多佛的日子，她的雇主弗兰克·拉普接到了一通电话。

sentences.en: It was from Karina's friend, who had accompanied her to Boston that weekend.
sentences.zh: 电话是那个周末陪她去波士顿的朋友打来的。

sentences.en: She was wondering if Karina had preemptively returned to Dover, as no one in the city knew where she was.
sentences.zh: 她想知道卡琳娜是否提前回了多佛，因为城里没人知道她在哪里。

sentences.en: Concerned, Frank drove to his loft.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克感到担忧，于是开车去了他的阁楼。

sentences.en: Upon entering, he saw some of Karina's belongings lying around, but the 19-year-old wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 进屋后，他看到卡琳娜的一些私人物品散落在各处，但这位19岁的女孩并不在。

sentences.en: As no one could pinpoint where Karina might have wound up after the clubs closed in the early hours of Saturday morning,
sentences.zh: 由于没人能确定卡琳娜在周六凌晨夜店关门后去了哪里，

sentences.en: Frank phoned the Boston police to report her missing.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克打电话给波士顿警方报了失踪。

sentences.en: Hours later, a homeless man made his way along Boylston Street.
sentences.zh: 几小时后，一名流浪汉沿着博伊尔斯顿街走着。

sentences.en: He passed the closed Zanzibar nightclub before turning down Ipswich Street at the end.
sentences.zh: 他经过了已关门的Zanzibar夜店，然后在尽头转入了伊普斯威奇街（Ipswich Street）。

sentences.en: Although connected to various main thoroughfares, the street itself was relatively quiet.
sentences.zh: 尽管这条街连接着几条主干道，但街道本身相对安静。

sentences.en: It ran parallel with a train track and was overlooked by several apartment blocks.
sentences.zh: 它与铁轨平行，上方俯瞰着几栋公寓楼。

sentences.en: On the other side of the railway was the Massachusetts Turnpike, and above was the Charles Gate Overpass.
sentences.zh: 铁路的另一边是马萨诸塞州收费公路，上方是查尔斯门立交桥（Charles Gate Overpass）。

sentences.en: As the homeless man walked along Ipswich Street, he checked dumpsters for recyclable cans that he could trade for cash.
sentences.zh: 当流浪汉沿着伊普斯威奇街走时，他翻找垃圾桶里的可回收罐头，想换点现金。

sentences.en: At around 1.30pm, he was examining a dumpster behind an apartment building and noticed a plastic garbage bag within.
sentences.zh: 下午1点30分左右，他在检查一栋公寓楼后的垃圾桶时，注意到里面有一个塑料垃圾袋。

sentences.en: Inside, he came across another plastic bag.
sentences.zh: 在里面，他发现了另一个塑料袋。

sentences.en: He untied this second bag and saw something horrifying.
sentences.zh: 他解开了第二个袋子，看到了令人毛骨悚然的一幕。

sentences.en: It was a woman's arm, her fingernails painted with nail polish.
sentences.zh: 那是一条女性的手臂，指甲上涂着指甲油。

sentences.en: Terrified, the man fled to notify the authorities.
sentences.zh: 惊恐万分的男子立刻跑去通知当局。

sentences.en: When police arrived at the scene, they discovered that the bag contained the upper half of a woman.
sentences.zh: 警方赶到现场后，发现袋子里装的是一名女性的上半身。

sentences.en: Her lower body and legs were missing.
sentences.zh: 她的下半身和双腿不见了。

sentences.en: It was Karina Holmer.
sentences.zh: 那是卡琳娜·霍尔默。

sentences.en: Faint ligature marks on Karina's neck indicated she had been strangled with a piece of rope or cord.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜颈部微弱的勒痕表明她曾被绳索或电线勒死。

sentences.en: Following her murder, Karina was severed in two, likely by a power saw.
sentences.zh: 谋杀发生后，卡琳娜被肢解成两部分，很可能是用电锯完成的。

sentences.en: Her makeup had been removed, and her body was completely washed clean.
sentences.zh: 她的妆容已被卸掉，遗体被彻底清洗干净。

sentences.en: It was believed that her remains were dumped on the Saturday, sometime after Karina had separated from her friends.
sentences.zh: 据信，她的遗体是在周六，即卡琳娜与朋友分开后的某个时间被抛弃的。

sentences.en: Her exact time of death was difficult to ascertain, as there were no markings on her body caused by blood settling.
sentences.zh: 由于尸体上没有尸斑，很难确定她的确切死亡时间。

sentences.en: This suggested she had either been held captive prior to her murder, or that she had lost too much blood during the act.
sentences.zh: 这表明她要么在被谋杀前曾被囚禁，要么是在行凶过程中失血过多。

sentences.en: The brutal way in which Karina had been mutilated by her killer or killers made her murder particularly unusual.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜被凶手以如此残忍的方式肢解，使得这起谋杀案显得格外不同寻常。

sentences.en: The Boston police, who were no strangers to homicides, were left shocked by Karina's treatment and vowed to catch those responsible.
sentences.zh: 波士顿警方对凶杀案并不陌生，但卡琳娜遗体的惨状让他们感到震惊，并誓要抓住凶手。

sentences.en: They speculated that her assailant had sawed her in half because it made her remains easier to transport.
sentences.zh: 他们推测凶手将她锯成两半是因为这样更容易搬运遗体。

sentences.en: Or perhaps it was done to cover up evidence of a sexual assault on the lower portion of her body.
sentences.zh: 或者，这可能是为了掩盖她下半身遭受性侵犯的证据。

sentences.en: Forensic psychologists believed the seemingly opportunistic crime was carried out by a first-time killer.
sentences.zh: 法医心理学家认为，这起看似投机性的犯罪是由一名初犯者实施的。

sentences.en: Despite the killer's inexperience, they were described as careful, cunning, and clever.
sentences.zh: 尽管凶手缺乏经验，但他们被形容为小心谨慎、狡猾且聪明。

sentences.en: They did not panic in the wake of the crime, and were in no rush to determine how and where to dispose of Karina's body.
sentences.zh: 他们在犯罪后没有惊慌失措，也不急于决定如何以及在哪里处理卡琳娜的遗体。

sentences.en: Alan Fox, Dean of the College of Criminal Justice at Northwestern University, said,
sentences.zh: 西北大学刑事司法学院院长艾伦·福克斯（Alan Fox）表示：

sentences.en: We're not talking about a bizarre maniac.
sentences.zh: “我们谈论的不是一个怪异的疯子。”

sentences.en: Either it's someone who had some relationship with Karina, or we're talking about a stranger who has a great deal of control over his behaviour.
sentences.zh: “要么是与卡琳娜有某种关系的人，要么是一个对自己行为有极强控制力的陌生人。”

sentences.en: Who could very well have a good job, and neighbours, and friends.
sentences.zh: “他很可能有一份体面的工作，有邻居，有朋友。”

sentences.en: But for whom rape and murder is done for pleasure.
sentences.zh: “但对他来说，强奸和谋杀是为了寻求快感。”

sentences.en: Lieutenant Robert O'Toole, who was assigned to the case, confirmed in the Boston Globe that initial investigations would focus on Karina's movements
sentences.zh: 负责此案的罗伯特·奥图尔（Robert O'Toole）警督在《波士顿环球报》上证实，初步调查将集中在卡琳娜的行踪上，

sentences.en: from the last time her friends reported seeing her.
sentences.zh: 从她朋友最后一次见到她时算起。

sentences.en: CCTV footage from inside and outside Zanzibar nightclub was taken for analysis.
sentences.zh: Zanzibar夜店内外拍摄的监控录像已被提取进行分析。

sentences.en: While the Boston Police Department had confirmed early on that the body was that of Karina Holmer,
sentences.zh: 虽然波士顿警察局很早就确认遗体就是卡琳娜·霍尔默，

sentences.en: when they went to check her name through all the various agencies that hired international au pairs, they received a surprise.
sentences.zh: 但当他们通过所有招聘国际互惠生的机构核查她的名字时，却得到了一个意外的结果。

sentences.en: Her name wasn't on any of them.
sentences.zh: 她的名字不在任何名单上。

sentences.en: Over in Sweden, Karina's parents returned from a night out to discover multiple messages on their home phone's answering machine.
sentences.zh: 在瑞典，卡琳娜的父母外出归来，发现家里电话的答录机上有好几条留言。

sentences.en: They were from the Boston Police, advising them of their daughter's murder.
sentences.zh: 那是波士顿警方打来的，告知他们女儿被谋杀的消息。

sentences.en: A media frenzy followed the discovery of Karina's body, and the story dominated headlines in Massachusetts and Sweden.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜遗体被发现后，媒体陷入了疯狂，这起故事占据了马萨诸塞州和瑞典的头条新闻。

sentences.en: Boston's mayor implored reporters to let investigators do their job without getting in the way.
sentences.zh: 波士顿市长恳求记者让调查人员各司其职，不要从中阻挠。

sentences.en: Karina's parents were repeatedly asked for interviews but were too distraught to speak with the press.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜的父母多次被要求接受采访，但他们悲痛欲绝，无法与媒体交谈。

sentences.en: Her sister, Johanna, provided a comment to the Boston Globe, stating,
sentences.zh: 她的姐姐约翰娜（Johanna）向《波士顿环球报》发表评论称：

sentences.en: Of course we know that such things can happen over there, but it's nothing that you expect.
sentences.zh: “我们当然知道那边可能会发生这种事，但这是你意想不到的。”

sentences.en: Karina's friends told the press she had been sensible but also very trusting of others
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜的朋友告诉媒体，她为人谨慎，但对他人也非常信任。

sentences.en: A Swedish salon owner who lived and worked in Boston attributed this to a difference in cultures, telling the Boston Globe, quote,
sentences.zh: 一位在波士顿生活和工作的瑞典沙龙老板将此归因于文化差异，他告诉《波士顿环球报》：

sentences.en: This is not Sweden, and the young girls don't realise that.
sentences.zh: “这里不是瑞典，年轻女孩们没有意识到这一点。”

sentences.en: There is much more violence around here, and you have to be careful, especially when you go drinking.
sentences.zh: “这里暴力事件更多，你必须小心，尤其是在出去喝酒的时候。”

sentences.en: Sweden is not like this.
sentences.zh: “瑞典不是这样的。”

sentences.en: Everything there is on a smaller scale.
sentences.zh: “那里的一切规模都较小。”

sentences.en: You are more protected.
sentences.zh: “你受到的保护更多。”

sentences.en: Or pair agencies offered counselling to nannies in the area, as many struggled to come to terms with the death of one of their friends.
sentences.zh: 互惠生机构为该地区的保姆提供了心理咨询，因为许多人难以接受朋友离世的事实。

sentences.en: A police spokesperson tried to calm the public and reassured them it was still safe to go out, stating,
sentences.zh: 一名警方发言人试图安抚公众，并向他们保证外出仍然是安全的，他表示：

sentences.en: There is not a mad killer running through Boston scooping up young women from clubs.
sentences.zh: “并没有一个疯狂的杀手在波士顿街头游荡，从夜店里抓走年轻女性。”

sentences.en: Still, local night spots saw a decrease in business, with many people reporting that they were choosing to stay home instead.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，当地夜店的生意还是有所下滑，许多人表示他们选择待在家里。

sentences.en: One woman around the same age as Karina said,
sentences.zh: 一位与卡琳娜年龄相仿的女性说：

sentences.en: I know people that won't even go out now, but if you do, it's worth it to take a cab.
sentences.zh: “我认识的人现在连门都不敢出，但如果你非要出去，打车是值得的。”

sentences.en: Five dollars can save your life.
sentences.zh: “五美元就能救你一命。”

sentences.en: Law enforcement officials painted Karina Holmer as a party animal who was known to go out clubbing often.
sentences.zh: 执法官员将卡琳娜·霍尔默描述为一个喜欢聚会的人，经常去夜店。

sentences.en: One source said it was difficult to track where she had gone and with whom, because she socialised with, quote,
sentences.zh: 一位消息人士称，很难追踪她去了哪里以及和谁在一起，因为她社交广泛，引用：

sentences.en: Karina's host mother, Susan Nicta, denied these allegations, telling the media that Karina had only been drinking a lot on the night she went missing
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜的寄宿母亲苏珊·尼克塔否认了这些指控，她告诉媒体，卡琳娜只是在失踪当晚喝多了，

sentences.en: because she was celebrating mid-summer, adding that this was probably why she got into trouble.
sentences.zh: 因为她在庆祝仲夏节，并补充说这可能就是她惹上麻烦的原因。

sentences.en: She described Karina as typically having very good judgement.
sentences.zh: 她形容卡琳娜通常非常有判断力。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, detectives discovered that Karina had gained employment in the United States through a Stockholm au pair agency run by 46-year-old Tage Sundin.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，侦探们发现卡琳娜是通过斯德哥尔摩一家由46岁的塔格·桑丁（Tage Sundin）经营的互惠生机构在美国找到工作的。

sentences.en: After learning of Karina's death, Sundin told Swedish newspaper Expressen that although his agency found work for au pairs,
sentences.zh: 得知卡琳娜的死讯后，桑丁告诉瑞典《快报》（Expressen），虽然他的机构为互惠生寻找工作，

sentences.en: he did not provide them with the special 13-month visa they required to work in the US.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有为她们提供在美国工作所需的特殊13个月签证。

sentences.en: This was why Karina's name was not recorded in any official documentation.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么卡琳娜的名字没有记录在任何官方文件中的原因。

sentences.en: Tage Sundin, who had previously been charged twice with illegal employment practices, admitted that au pairs, including Karina Holmer, were technically illegal immigrants.
sentences.zh: 塔格·桑丁曾两次因非法就业行为被起诉，他承认包括卡琳娜·霍尔默在内的互惠生在技术上属于非法移民。

sentences.en: Although most official agencies checked in with their overseas au pairs to see how they were going, he hadn't heard from Karina since she left Sweden.
sentences.zh: 虽然大多数正规机构会与海外互惠生保持联系，了解她们的情况，但他自卡琳娜离开瑞典后就没再收到过她的消息。

sentences.en: He was devastated by Karina's murder and publicly claimed responsibility for her death, closing down his business soon after.
sentences.zh: 他对卡琳娜的谋杀案感到悲痛欲绝，并公开承担了责任，不久后便关闭了公司。

sentences.en: While Boston police said that finding out more about Karina would help them track down her killer,
sentences.zh: 虽然波士顿警方表示，更多地了解卡琳娜将有助于他们追踪凶手，

sentences.en: a spokesperson was quick to point out that investigators were no closer to finding them.
sentences.zh: 但一位发言人很快指出，调查人员距离找到凶手还很遥远。

sentences.en: A criminologist discussed Karina's case with the Boston Globe, saying,
sentences.zh: 一位犯罪学家与《波士顿环球报》讨论了卡琳娜的案件，他说：

sentences.en: These kinds of events are incredibly rare.
sentences.zh: “这类事件极其罕见。”

sentences.en: The mutilation of a body is not common in homicide.
sentences.zh: “在凶杀案中，肢解遗体并不常见。”

sentences.en: When it does happen, it gets a lot of attention and we tend to think it's more common than it is.
sentences.zh: “当它发生时，会引起极大的关注，我们往往会认为它比实际情况更常见。”

sentences.en: Although Karina had only been in the US for approximately three months, investigators worked with the theory that she knew her killer.
sentences.zh: 尽管卡琳娜在美国仅待了大约三个月，但调查人员推测她认识凶手。

sentences.en: As it turned out, there were multiple people of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，确实有多个相关嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile 节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告，以此支持我们的节目。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持 Casefile 继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Karina's employer, Frank Rapp, caught the attention of detectives early in the investigation.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜的雇主弗兰克·拉普在调查初期就引起了侦探们的注意。

sentences.en: As one of the individuals closest to Karina, the 43-year-old had to be questioned.
sentences.zh: 作为与卡琳娜关系最亲近的人之一，这位 43 岁的男子必须接受问话。

sentences.en: Investigators first spoke to Frank the day after Karina's body was identified.
sentences.zh: 调查人员在卡琳娜的遗体被确认身份后的第二天首次与弗兰克谈话。

sentences.en: He gave an alibi for the night in question, telling detectives that after Karina left with her friend to celebrate midsummer,
sentences.zh: 他为案发当晚提供了不在场证明，告诉侦探，在卡琳娜和朋友出去庆祝仲夏节之后，

sentences.en: he went with Susan and his children to McDonald's and a drive-in movie theatre.
sentences.zh: 他和苏珊以及孩子们去了麦当劳和一家汽车影院。

sentences.en: After that, they all returned to their home in Dover, where Frank stayed for the remainder of the weekend.
sentences.zh: 之后，他们都回到了位于多佛的家中，弗兰克在那个周末剩下的时间里都待在那里。

sentences.en: His wife Susan confirmed this, as did her parents, who had been staying with them at the time.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子苏珊证实了这一点，当时住在他们家的岳父母也予以证实。

sentences.en: A background check showed that Frank Rapp had previously run into trouble with the law.
sentences.zh: 背景调查显示，弗兰克·拉普此前曾有过法律纠纷。

sentences.en: Five years earlier, in 1991, he was arrested for physically assaulting Susan.
sentences.zh: 五年前，即 1991 年，他因殴打苏珊而被捕。

sentences.en: As reported in the Boston Globe,
sentences.zh: 据《波士顿环球报》报道，

sentences.en: Frank appeared in court on charges of assault and battery.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克因袭击和殴打指控出庭受审。

sentences.en: Susan filed a restraining order against him, but later asked that it be removed and all charges against Frank be dropped after he agreed to treatment for alcoholism.
sentences.zh: 苏珊曾对他申请过限制令，但在他同意接受酗酒治疗后，她后来要求撤销限制令并撤销对弗兰克的所有指控。

sentences.en: Although Susan Nicta refused to elaborate on the incident when interviewed by the media, she did say that the arrest turned out to be a very positive thing for both of them.
sentences.zh: 尽管苏珊·尼克塔在接受媒体采访时拒绝详细说明此事，但她确实表示，这次逮捕对他们两人来说都是一件非常积极的事情。

sentences.en: Later adding,
sentences.zh: 随后她补充道：

sentences.en: What happened with Frank and I in the past is not going to do anything to help find this person who killed Karina.
sentences.zh: “我和弗兰克过去发生的事情对寻找杀害卡琳娜的凶手没有任何帮助。”

sentences.en: I have a very solid, loving relationship with my husband.
sentences.zh: “我和我丈夫的关系非常稳固且充满爱意。”

sentences.en: Susan told the Boston Globe that Karina was the perfect playmate and caregiver for her children, stating,
sentences.zh: 苏珊告诉《波士顿环球报》，卡琳娜是她孩子们的完美玩伴和看护人，并表示：

sentences.en: Frank added that their thoughts and prayers were with Karina's family.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克补充说，他们的思念和祈祷与卡琳娜的家人同在。

sentences.en: The evening after Frank's first police interview, homicide detectives and cadaver dogs descended on his downtown loft.
sentences.zh: 在弗兰克首次接受警方问话后的那天晚上，凶杀组侦探和搜尸犬搜查了他的市中心阁楼。

sentences.en: After a six-hour search, they left with six bags of evidence, including a bag full of Karina's clothing and what was described in the media as soft pornography.
sentences.zh: 经过六个小时的搜查，他们带走了六袋证物，其中包括一袋装满卡琳娜衣物的袋子，以及媒体所描述的软色情物品。

sentences.en: Detectives hoped that an examination of the apartment might reveal whether Karina made it back there after her night out at Zanzibar.
sentences.zh: 侦探们希望通过对公寓的检查，能查明卡琳娜在桑给巴尔夜店度过那一晚后是否回到了那里。

sentences.en: However, this was unable to be determined.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一点无法确定。

sentences.en: There were no signs that anything untoward occurred in the loft, with cadaver dogs failing to pick up anything of forensic importance.
sentences.zh: 阁楼里没有任何迹象表明发生了什么不寻常的事情，搜尸犬也没有发现任何具有法医价值的线索。

sentences.en: That same night, approximately 30 hours after Karina's body was found, a fire broke out in a dumpster approximately 200 feet from Frank and Susan's Dover home.
sentences.zh: 就在同一天晚上，大约在卡琳娜的遗体被发现 30 小时后，弗兰克和苏珊在多佛家附近约 200 英尺处的一个垃圾箱里发生了火灾。

sentences.en: The blazer's proximity to the Rapp household did not go unnoticed by police, who requested a second interview with Frank the next day.
sentences.zh: 垃圾箱距离拉普家很近，这引起了警方的注意，他们要求第二天对弗兰克进行第二次问话。

sentences.en: This time, he attended homicide headquarters with his lawyer.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他在律师的陪同下前往凶杀组总部。

sentences.en: Once the interrogation was over,
sentences.zh: 审讯结束后，

sentences.en: Frank told the Boston Globe that he had been ruled out of the investigation, stating,
sentences.zh: 弗兰克告诉《波士顿环球报》，他已被排除在调查之外，并称：

sentences.en: Lieutenant Robert O'Toole disputed this assertion in a news conference, explaining that while investigators had interviewed a number of people, they hadn't ruled anyone in or out.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·奥图尔中尉在新闻发布会上反驳了这一说法，解释说虽然调查人员已经询问了许多人，但他们并没有排除或锁定任何嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Later that afternoon,
sentences.zh: 当天下午晚些时候，

sentences.en: Boston police searched through the dumpster that was set on fire near Frank and Susan's home.
sentences.zh: 波士顿警方搜查了弗兰克和苏珊家附近那个起火的垃圾箱。

sentences.en: Amongst the ash were the burnt remnants of some women's clothing.
sentences.zh: 在灰烬中发现了一些女性衣物的烧焦残骸。

sentences.en: No human remains were found.
sentences.zh: 没有发现人类遗骸。

sentences.en: Police carried away three bags of evidence, and the dumpster was transported to the Dover Highway Department under police guard.
sentences.zh: 警方带走了三袋证物，垃圾箱在警方的看守下被运往多佛公路部门。

sentences.en: Later reports confirmed that the clothing did not match Karina Holmer's.
sentences.zh: 后来的报告证实，这些衣物与卡琳娜·霍尔默的不符。

sentences.en: But investigators soon made a notable discovery.
sentences.zh: 但调查人员很快有了重大发现。

sentences.en: On Saturday June 22, the day that detectives suspected Karina was murdered,
sentences.zh: 6 月 22 日星期六，即侦探怀疑卡琳娜遇害的那一天，

sentences.en: Frank Rapp had obtained a permit to dump trash at a Dover recycling facility.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·拉普获得了一份在多佛回收站倾倒垃圾的许可证。

sentences.en: On Thursday June 27, detectives headed to the facility.
sentences.zh: 6 月 27 日星期四，侦探们前往该设施。

sentences.en: They spent five hours sifting through refuse and carted away two dumpster loads in an attempt to find evidence linking Frank to Karina's murder.
sentences.zh: 他们花了五个小时翻找垃圾，并运走了两卡车垃圾，试图寻找将弗兰克与卡琳娜谋杀案联系起来的证据。

sentences.en: Susan Nicta said in an interview with the Boston Globe that, like the dumpster fire, the permit was nothing more than, quote,
sentences.zh: 苏珊·尼克塔在接受《波士顿环球报》采访时表示，就像垃圾箱火灾一样，这张许可证只不过是，引用她的话：

sentences.en: a weird coincidence.
sentences.zh: “一个奇怪的巧合。”

sentences.en: She explained that Frank had gone to the facility to recycle newspapers and had taken their son and their nephew with him.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，弗兰克去那个设施是为了回收报纸，并带上了他们的儿子和侄子。

sentences.en: Then she added,
sentences.zh: 然后她补充道：

sentences.en: Frank has an airtight alibi.
sentences.zh: “弗兰克有完美的不在场证明。”

sentences.en: Anyone who knows Frank knows he does not have it in him to hurt somebody else.
sentences.zh: “任何认识弗兰克的人都知道，他根本不可能伤害别人。”

sentences.en: But law enforcement officials maintained that the apparent coincidence was, quote, definitely suspicious.
sentences.zh: 但执法官员坚持认为，这个明显的巧合，引用他们的话，是“绝对可疑的”。

sentences.en: While Frank Rapp and Susan Nicta described Karina as happy and carefree, others had a different impression of the 19-year-old's short time in the US.
sentences.zh: 虽然弗兰克·拉普和苏珊·尼克塔形容卡琳娜快乐且无忧无虑，但其他人对这位 19 岁女孩在美国的短暂时光有着不同的印象。

sentences.en: One of Karina's friends in Sweden contacted police about some correspondence she had received from Karina.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜在瑞典的一位朋友联系了警方，谈到了她收到的一些来自卡琳娜的信件。

sentences.en: In one letter,
sentences.zh: 在其中一封信里，

sentences.en: Karina said she was homesick and wanted to return in August, which would mean cutting her trip short.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜说她很想家，想在八月份回去，这意味着要缩短她的行程。

sentences.en: Karina also confided in another friend named Ulrika Svensson.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜还向另一位名叫乌尔丽卡·斯文森的朋友吐露了心声。

sentences.en: A letter to Ulrika read,
sentences.zh: 写给乌尔丽卡的一封信中写道：

sentences.en: There is always so much cleaning and I think I am stressed all the time, so this is not exactly what I thought it would be.
sentences.zh: “总是有做不完的清洁工作，我觉得我一直处于压力之中，所以这和我想象的完全不一样。”

sentences.en: Just weeks before Karina's murder,
sentences.zh: 就在卡琳娜遇害前几周，

sentences.en: Ulrika received another letter.
sentences.zh: 乌尔丽卡收到了另一封信。

sentences.en: This one was more ominous.
sentences.zh: 这封信更令人不安。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用信中内容：

sentences.en: Something terrible has happened.
sentences.zh: “发生了一件可怕的事情。”

sentences.en: I cannot tell you right now what it is, but I will tell you when I get home.
sentences.zh: “我现在不能告诉你是什么事，但我回家后会告诉你的。”

sentences.en: None of Karina's friends or family had any idea what terrible thing she was referring to.
sentences.zh: 卡琳娜的朋友和家人都不知道她所说的可怕事情是指什么。

sentences.en: On Sunday June 30, a week after Karina's body was found,
sentences.zh: 6 月 30 日星期日，即卡琳娜的遗体被发现一周后，

sentences.en: 50 of her friends and other au pairs gathered in Boston's public gardens across the road from Zanzibar Nightclub for an impromptu memorial service.
sentences.zh: 她的 50 名朋友和其他互惠生聚集在桑给巴尔夜店对面的波士顿公园，举行了一场即兴追悼会。

sentences.en: Detectives observed them from afar, videotaping the service in the hopes that a person of interest might show up.
sentences.zh: 侦探们在远处观察，并录下了追悼会的过程，希望有相关人员出现。

sentences.en: After holding hands and praying for Karina, the group made their way to a chain-link fence near the dumpster where Karina was found and decorated it with brightly coloured roses.
sentences.zh: 在手牵手为卡琳娜祈祷后，这群人来到发现卡琳娜的垃圾箱附近的铁丝网围栏旁，用鲜艳的玫瑰装饰了它。

sentences.en: Afterwards, detectives questioned some attendees and were able to further account for Karina's final movements.
sentences.zh: 事后，侦探们询问了一些参加者，并得以进一步还原了卡琳娜最后的行踪。

sentences.en: During the night, Karina was seen dancing and talking with two men in Zanzibar.
sentences.zh: 当晚，有人看到卡琳娜在桑给巴尔夜店与两名男子跳舞和交谈。

sentences.en: Witnesses described the men as well-dressed.
sentences.zh: 目击者形容这两名男子衣着考究。

sentences.en: It was unclear whether they were the same men
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚他们是否就是

sentences.en: Karina was seen talking to on the street after the club closed, but one of her friends thought they might be.
